steps.decide: What is being chosen: a date, a range, a time, or a recurring schedule
How a typed date is parsed, and in which locale and format it is displayed
The keyboard model for the grid and how the reader reaches it
How invalid, out-of-range and past dates are refused, with a reason
How time zones and relative entry ('tomorrow') are handled

rules.statement: A single date is a text input with a calendar as an optional aid; a range uses two inputs with a shared calendar; a recurring schedule is not a date picker at all.
Typing is always possible and always faster: the input accepts the locale's format and an unpadded ISO form, displays the locale format, and never silently reinterprets a day/month swap.
Arrows move by day, PageUp/PageDown by month, Home/End to the week's edges, Enter selects and Escape closes back to the input; the grid has a roving tabindex and announces the full date.
A disabled day states why (before the project start, not a business day) via aria-disabled plus an explanation near the input, and a typed out-of-range date is refused with the same reason.
The chosen date is stored with its meaning stated: a calendar date stays a date, an instant is stored in UTC with the zone shown, and the interface never silently converts one into the other.

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a month grid request applies only to the month currently displayed; a slower previous month never replaces the grid the reader is looking at

transitions.trigger: the calendar is opened from the input

motion.motion: the calendar fades and offsets into place over 160ms
motion.reducedMotion: the calendar appears instantly in place

transitions.trigger: the calendar is closed or Escape is pressed

motion.reducedMotion: the calendar disappears instantly and focus returns to the input

transitions.trigger: a month of availability is fetched

motion.motion: available days show a static muted state over 120ms
motion.reducedMotion: the muted day states appear instantly

motion.motion: the grid stays navigable with a note that availability is unknown over 120ms
motion.reducedMotion: the note appears instantly above the grid

motion.motion: the field's error text expands over 120ms

transitions.trigger: the reader corrects the date and opens the calendar

motion.motion: the calendar opens over 160ms with the corrected month shown
motion.reducedMotion: the calendar appears instantly on the corrected month

motion.motion: the focus ring disappears with no delay
motion.reducedMotion: identical — the ring is immediate in both cases

motion.noneReason: unavailability is a permission or load fact, not an animation; the control states why instead of moving

sections.intent: Let a reader enter or choose a date quickly by keyboard, in their own format, and know exactly which day the product will store.
useCases: set a due date by typing
see which days are unavailable and why
nicheDifferences: Dates are where locale, time zone and keyboard meet, and the classic bug is a day that shifts by one
The picker's job is to remove ambiguity, not to look like a calendar
inputs: whether the value is a calendar date, an instant, or a range
the locales and formats in use
the time zone the reader is in versus the one stored
anatomy: a text input with a format hint
a calendar button that opens a labelled dialog
a month grid with roving tabindex
an error line for refused values
styling: the calendar is 320 px wide with 44 px day targets
selected range ends are distinguished from the range body
today has a ring, not a fill, so selection stays legible
a11y: the input has a label and a format example in its description
the grid is a role=grid with roving tabindex and arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown support
selected days expose aria-selected and the full date as their name
disabled days use aria-disabled with a reason near the input
Escape closes and restores focus to the input
responsive: at 320 px the calendar becomes a full-width sheet with the same keyboard model
the input accepts the locale's date order while the hint shows it
the range variant stacks the two inputs above the calendar
copy: a refusal reads 'That date is before the project start (1 Nov 2026)'
a range reads 'From 14 Nov 2026 to 28 Nov 2026'
alternatives: three separate selects for day, month and year when the range is wide
a relative entry field ('in 2 weeks') when scheduling is approximate
a schedule builder for recurring patterns
acceptance: typing a date works in the locale format and an unpadded ISO form
arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End, Enter and Escape all work on the grid
a refused date states the range and the reason in text
a calendar date and an instant are stored distinctly, with the zone shown
the calendar returns focus to the input when it closes
failureCases: the picker shows MM/DD while the locale expects DD/MM, so 03/04 becomes March
the grid cannot be reached or driven by keyboard
a selected date shifts by one day when the reader crosses a time zone
unavailable days are greyed with no explanation

refused.reason: a disabled date field is replaced by plain text stating the fixed date
a range with one untouchable end is two separate fields with different permissions
